summary: USA Compression Partners, LP and its wholly-owned finance subsidiary filed an 8-K on September 24, 2026 detailing entry into a material definitive agreement. On September 18, 2026, the Issuers closed a private placement of $600 million aggregate principal amount of 6.750% senior notes due 2035, issued under an indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee. The notes are guaranteed jointly and severally on a senior unsecured basis by existing and future restricted subsidiaries. Net proceeds will repay outstanding credit agreement borrowings and pay offering fees. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
